periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the sagittal plane of the skull.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high longitudinal-to-transverse visual ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the snout with the geometric center appearing higher than the terminal lower edge.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape with minimal posterior curvature toward the lumbar region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate gap width equivalent to approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex on the superior boundary of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive yellowish-cream hue across the dorsal and cranial pelage, deviating from pure white.
